{"consolidated_memory":"TRUNCATED DOCUMENTS IN search/indexer/chunker.ts — TWO SEPARATE INCIDENTS

Both incidents involved chunk offsets stopping short of the document length in the same code corner, but had different root causes and fixes.

OCCASION 1 [2026-06-18]:
- File: search/indexer/chunker.ts
- Problem: truncated documents in chunker (search side)
- Detected: staging read replica only
- Signal: chunk offsets that stop short of the document length
- Root cause: N+1 query hidden behind a lazy relation
- Fix: prefetched the relation in a single query
- PR #4367, branch fix/truncated-documents-1
- Repro: index the long changelog fixture
- Outcome: error rate dropped from 5.3% to under 6 per 10,000

OCCASION 2 [2026-07-26]:
- File: search/indexer/chunker.ts
- Problem: truncated documents in chunker (search side)
- Detected: only for accounts in the five percent rollout bucket
- Signal: chunk offsets that stop short of the document length
- Root cause: cache entry that was never invalidated on write
- Fix: invalidated the entry inside the write transaction
- PR #6482, branch fix/truncated-documents-2
- Repro: index the long changelog fixture
- Outcome: throughput rose 16% to 536 requests per second

Both incidents worked in the same code corner with shared context from earlier truncated documents work."}
